  40: export function appendVideoPromptSuffix(prompt: string, suffix: string): string {
  41:   const base = String(prompt || "").trim();
  42:   const tail = String(suffix || "").trim();
  43:   if (!tail) return base;
  44:   if (!base) return tail;
  45:   if (base === tail || base.endsWith(`\n${tail}`) || base.endsWith(`\n\n${tail}`)) return base;
  46:   return `${base}\n\n${tail}`;
  47: }

 139: function providerUrl(raw: string, label: string): string {
 140:   let parsed: URL;
 141:   try {
 142:     parsed = new URL(raw);
 143:   } catch {
 144:     throw new Error(`${label}鎺ュ彛鍦板潃鏃犳晥`);
 145:   }
 146:   if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" || parsed.username || parsed.password) {
 147:     throw new Error(`${label}鎺ュ彛鍦板潃蹇呴』浣跨敤 HTTPS`);
 148:   }
 149:   return parsed.toString().replace(/\/$/, "");
 150: }

 152: async function readResponseBody(response: Response): Promise<string> {
 153:   const text = await response.text();
 154:   return text.slice(0, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
 155: }

 157: async function fetchJson(
 158:   url: string,
 159:   init: RequestInit,
 160:   label: string,
 161: ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
 162:   const controller = new AbortController();
 163:   const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
 164:   try {
 165:     const response = await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: controller.signal, redirect: "error" });
 166:     const text = await readResponseBody(response);
 167:     if (!response.ok) {
 168:       throw new Error(`${label}璇锋眰澶辫触锛圚TTP ${response.status}锛?{extractErrorDetail(text)}`);
 169:     }
 170:     let payload: unknown;
 171:     try {
 172:       payload = JSON.parse(text);
 173:     } catch {
 174:       throw new Error(`${label}杩斿洖浜嗘棤鏁?JSON`);
 175:     }
 176:     if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || Array.isArray(payload)) {
 177:       throw new Error(`${label}杩斿洖鏍煎紡涓嶆纭甡);
 178:     }
 179:     return payload as Record<string, unknown>;
 180:   } catch (error) {
 181:     if (error instanceof Error && error.name === "AbortError") throw new Error(`${label}璇锋眰瓒呮椂`);
 182:     throw error;
 183:   } finally {
 184:     clearTimeout(timeout);
 185:   }
 186: }

 188: function extractErrorDetail(text: string): string {
 189:   try {
 190:     const payload = JSON.parse(text) as { error?: unknown; message?: unknown; detail?: unknown };
 191:     const error = payload.error;
 192:     const value = error && typeof error === "object" && !Array.isArray(error)
 193:       ? (error as { message?: unknown; detail?: unknown }).message ?? (error as { detail?: unknown }).detail
 194:       : error ?? payload.message ?? payload.detail;
 195:     return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? `锛?{value.trim().slice(0, 500)}` : "";
 196:   } catch {
 197:     return "";
 198:   }
 199: }

  30: function sameOrigin(req: Request): boolean {
  31:   const origin = req.headers.get("origin");
  32:   if (!origin) return false;
  33:   try {
  34:     const requestUrl = new URL(req.url);
  35:     const host = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-host")?.split(",", 1)[0].trim() || req.headers.get("host") || requestUrl.host;
  36:     const protocol = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.split(",", 1)[0].trim() || requestUrl.protocol.slice(0, -1);
  37:     const originUrl = new URL(origin);
  38:     return originUrl.host === host && originUrl.protocol === `${protocol}:`;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return false;
  41:   }
  42: }

  73: export function getVideoDurationOptions(capability: VideoCapability): number[] {
  74:   if (capability.duration.values?.length) return [...capability.duration.values];
  75:   const count = capability.duration.max - capability.duration.min + 1;
  76:   return Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, count) }, (_, index) => capability.duration.min + index);
  77: }

 250:       console.error("Workspace video task failure could not be persisted", { taskId, error: updateError });

  61: async function cleanupExpired(directory: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<void> {
  62:   await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });

  73: function cloudflaredUrl(text: string): string | null {

  78: async function listenOnLoopback(server: Server): Promise<number> {
  79:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  80:     const onError = (error: Error) => {
  81:       server.off("listening", onListening);
  82:       reject(error);
  83:     };
  84:     const onListening = () => {
  85:       server.off("error", onError);
  86:       const address = server.address();
  87:       if (!address || typeof address === "string") {
  88:         reject(new Error("视频参考图桥接服务未获得监听端口"));
  89:         return;
  90:       }
  91:       resolve(address.port);
  92:     };
  93:     server.once("error", onError);
  94:     server.once("listening", onListening);
  95:     server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1");
  96:   });
  97: }
  98: 
  99: async function closeServer(server: Server): Promise<void> {
 100:   if (!server.listening) return;
 101:   await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
 102: }

 104: async function ensureAutoBridge(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<AutoBridge> {
 105:   if (autoBridgePromise) {
 106:     const current = await autoBridgePromise.catch(() => null);
 107:     if (current && current.process.exitCode === null) return current;
 108:     autoBridgePromise = null;
 109:   }

 111:   autoBridgePromise = (async () => {

 115:       const requestUrl = new URL(request.url ?? "/", "http://127.0.0.1");

 117:         ? requestUrl.pathname.slice("/ref/".length)
 118:         : "";

 122:         response.end();
 123:         return;
 124:       }
 125:       response.writeHead(200, {
 126:         "Content-Type": reference.mimeType,

 129:         "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
 130:       });

 137:       stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
 138:       windowsHide: true,
 139:     });
 140:     activeTunnel = tunnel;

 142:     let settled = false;
 143:     const publicBase = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {

 145:         if (settled) return;
 146:         settled = true;

 148:       }, 45_000);
 149:       const onOutput = (chunk: Buffer | string) => {
 150:         output.push(String(chunk).trim());
 151:         if (output.length > 20) output.shift();
 152:         const url = cloudflaredUrl(String(chunk));
 153:         if (!url || settled) return;
 154:         settled = true;
 155:         clearTimeout(timer);
 156:         resolve(url);
 157:       };
 158:       tunnel.stdout.on("data", onOutput);
 159:       tunnel.stderr.on("data", onOutput);
 160:       tunnel.once("error", (error) => {
 161:         if (settled) return;
 162:         settled = true;
 163:         clearTimeout(timer);
 164:         reject(new Error(`视频参考图公网隧道启动失败：${error.message}`));
 165:       });
 166:       tunnel.once("exit", (code) => {
 167:         if (settled) return;
 168:         settled = true;
 169:         clearTimeout(timer);
 170:         reject(new Error(`视频参考图公网隧道已退出（${code ?? "unknown"}）`));
 171:       });
 172:     }).catch(async (error) => {
 173:       tunnel.kill();
 174:       await closeServer(server);
 175:       throw error;
 176:     });
 177:     const bridge = { server, process: tunnel, publicBase };
 178:     tunnel.once("exit", () => {
 179:       if (activeTunnel === tunnel) activeTunnel = null;
 180:       if (autoBridgePromise) autoBridgePromise = null;
 181:       void closeServer(server);
 182:     });
 183:     return bridge;
 184:   })();
 185:   return autoBridgePromise;
 186: }

 188: async function resolvePublicBase(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<string> {
 189:   try {
 190:     const configured = String(env[PUBLIC_BASE_ENV] ?? "").trim();
 191:     if (configured) return publicBaseUrl(env);
 192:     return (await ensureAutoBridge(env)).publicBase;
 193:   } catch (error) {
 194:     if (error instanceof ReferenceTunnelError) throw error;
 195:     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "视频参考图公网隧道不可用";
 196:     throw new ReferenceTunnelError(message);
 197:   }

 204: export async function waitForPublicReference(url: string, fetcher: typeof fetch = fetch): Promise<void> {
 205:   let lastFailure = "unknown error";
 206:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < PUBLIC_REFERENCE_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1) {
 207:     try {
 208:       const response = await fetcher(url, { method: "HEAD", redirect: "error" });
 209:       if (response.ok) return;
 210:       lastFailure = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
 211:     } catch (error) {
 212:       lastFailure = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "network error";
 213:     }
 214:     if (attempt < PUBLIC_REFERENCE_ATTEMPTS - 1) {
 215:       await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, PUBLIC_REFERENCE_RETRY_DELAY_MS));
 216:     }
 217:   }
 218:   throw new ReferenceTunnelError(`视频参考图公网地址不可访问：${lastFailure}`);
 219: }

 221: export async function publishPublicReferenceImage(input: {
 222:   mimeType: string;
 223:   dataBase64: string;
 224:   env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
 225: }): Promise<string> {
 226:   const suffix = MIME_SUFFIXES[input.mimeType.toLowerCase()];
 227:   if (!suffix) throw new Error("视频参考图必须是 JPG、PNG 或 WebP 图片");
 228:   if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(input.dataBase64) || input.dataBase64.length % 4 !== 0) {
 229:     throw new Error("视频参考图数据格式不正确");
 230:   }
 231:   const bytes = Buffer.from(input.dataBase64, "base64");
 236:   const env = input.env ?? process.env;
 237:   const configuredBase = String(env[PUBLIC_BASE_ENV] ?? "").trim();
 238:   const base = await resolvePublicBase(env);
 239:   const directory = cacheDir(env);
 240:   await cleanupExpired(directory);
 241:   const token = `${randomBytes(32).toString("hex")}${suffix}`;
 242:   validateToken(token);
 243:   const target = path.join(directory, token);
 244:   const temporary = `${target}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
 245:   try {
 246:     await writeFile(temporary, bytes, { flag: "wx" });
 247:     await rename(temporary, target);
 248:   } catch (error) {
 249:     await rm(temporary, { force: true }).catch(() => undefined);
 250:     throw error;
 251:   }
 252:   const publicPath = configuredBase
 253:     ? `/api/workspace/minimax-reference/${token}`
 254:     : `/ref/${token}`;
 255:   const publicUrl = `${base}${publicPath}`;
 256:   await waitForPublicReference(publicUrl);
 257:   return publicUrl;
 258: }

 264: export async function readMiniMaxReference(token: string, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): Promise<{
 265:   bytes: Buffer;
 266:   mimeType: string;
 267: } | null> {
 268:   validateToken(token);
 269:   const target = path.join(cacheDir(env), token);
 270:   const root = path.resolve(cacheDir(env));
 271:   if (path.dirname(path.resolve(target)) !== root) return null;
 272:   const details = await lstat(target).catch(() => null);
 273:   if (!details || details.isSymbolicLink() || !details.isFile()) return null;
 274:   if (Date.now() - details.mtimeMs > REFERENCE_TTL_MS) {
 275:     await rm(target, { force: true });
 276:     return null;
 277:   }
 278:   const suffix = path.extname(token).toLowerCase();
 279:   const mimeType = suffix === ".png" ? "image/png" : suffix === ".webp" ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
 280:   return { bytes: await readFile(target), mimeType };
 281: }

 289:     : DEFAULT_CLOUDFLARED_PATH;

**实际上游请求**

```http
POST https://snumom.com/v1/videos
Accept: application/json

Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: WorkspaceProduction/1.0
```

当前供应商模型名是：

```text
grok-imagine-video-1.5（按次）
```

无参考图时，请求体为：

```json
{
  "model": "grok-imagine-video-1.5（按次）",
  "prompt": "<最终视频提示词>",
  "duration": 10,
  "extra": {
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
    "resolution": "720p"
  }
}
```

选择 **1 张参考图**时，使用顶层 `input_reference`：

```json
{
  "model": "grok-imagine-video-1.5（按次）",
  "prompt": "<最终视频提示词>",
  "duration": 10,
  "input_reference": "https://operation-place.nat100.top/api/workspace/minimax-reference/<token>.jpg",
  "extra": {
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
    "resolution": "720p"
  }
}
```

选择 **2 至 7 张参考图**时，不再传 `input_reference`，改为 `extra.reference_images`：

```json
{
  "model": "grok-imagine-video-1.5（按次）",
  "prompt": "<最终视频提示词>",
  "duration": 10,
  "extra": {
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "reference_images": [
      {
        "url": "https://operation-place.nat100.top/api/workspace/minimax-reference/<token-1>.jpg",
        "role": "reference_image"
      },
      {
        "url": "https://operation-place.nat100.top/api/workspace/minimax-reference/<token-2>.png",
        "role": "reference_image"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

参考图不会以 Base64 直接传给 Grok。服务端会先把本地素材转换成临时公网 HTTPS 地址，再写入上述字段。

**当前参数限制**

- `duration`：整数，`6` 到 `30` 秒，页面默认 `10`
- `aspect_ratio`：`9:16`、`16:9`、`1:1`
- `resolution`：`480p`、`720p`，页面默认选择最高的 `720p`
- 参考图：`0` 到 `7` 张
- `prompt`：手动提示词，或模板生成的子提示词；开启后缀时，服务端会把已保存的后缀追加到最终提示词
- `count`：页面允许 `1` 到 `4`，但它只决定创建多少个独立任务，不会进入单次 Grok 上游请求

**浏览器提交到 3000 端口的内部请求**

```http
POST /api/workspace/accounts/{accountId}/generate-video
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "supplierId": "grok-video",
  "modelId": "grok",
  "promptMode": "manual",
  "prompt": "<视频提示词>",
  "promptModel": "gpt-2999",
  "suffixEnabled": false,
  "duration": 10,
  "aspectRatio": "9:16",
  "resolution": "720p",
  "count": 1,
  "referenceAssetId": "<第一张素材ID，可省略>",
  "referenceAssetIds": ["<素材ID，可省略>"]
}
```

浏览器请求只负责创建本地任务；后台 worker 随后才会调用 `https://snumom.com/v1/videos`。

**状态查询**

提交响应需要包含 `task_id`、`id` 或 `video_id` 之一。之后系统通过以下请求轮询：

```http
GET https://snumom.com/v1/videos/{providerTaskId}
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <GROK_VIDEO_API_KEY>
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: WorkspaceProduction/1.0
```

没有流式字段，也没有 `stream: true`。请求和状态响应都是等待完整响应文本后再执行 `JSON.parse`。

  40: export function appendVideoPromptSuffix(prompt: string, suffix: string): string {
  41:   const base = String(prompt || "").trim();
  42:   const tail = String(suffix || "").trim();
  43:   if (!tail) return base;
  44:   if (!base) return tail;
  45:   if (base === tail || base.endsWith(`\n${tail}`) || base.endsWith(`\n\n${tail}`)) return base;
  46:   return `${base}\n\n${tail}`;
  47: }

  49: export function buildOaiRegboxPayload(input: {
  50:   model: string;
  51:   prompt: string;
  52:   duration: number;
  53:   aspectRatio: string;
  54:   references: VideoReference[];
  55: }): Record<string, unknown> {
  56:   const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
  57:     model: input.model,

  59:     seconds: input.duration,
  60:     aspect_ratio: input.aspectRatio,
  61:   };
  62:   if (input.references.length === 1) {
  63:     payload.image_url = dataUrl(input.references[0]);
  64:   } else if (input.references.length > 1) {
  65:     throw new Error("OAIRegBox 褰撳墠宸查獙璇佸绾﹀彧鏀寔 1 寮犲弬鑰冨浘");
  66:   }

  70: export function buildGrokVideoPayload(input: {
  71:   model: string;
  72:   prompt: string;
  73:   duration: number;
  74:   aspectRatio: string;
  75:   resolution: string;
  76:   referenceUrls: readonly string[];
  77: }): Record<string, unknown> {
  78:   const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
  79:     model: input.model,
  80:     prompt: input.prompt,
  81:     duration: input.duration,
  82:     extra: {
  83:       aspect_ratio: input.aspectRatio,
  84:       resolution: input.resolution,
  85:     },
  86:   };
  87:   if (input.referenceUrls.length === 1) {
  88:     payload.input_reference = input.referenceUrls[0];
  89:   } else if (input.referenceUrls.length > 1) {
  90:     const extra = payload.extra as Record<string, unknown>;
  91:     payload.extra = {
  92:       ...extra,
  93:       reference_images: input.referenceUrls.map((url) => ({ url, role: "reference_image" })),
  94:     };
  95:   }
  96:   return payload;
  97: }

  99: export function buildMiniMaxPayload(input: {
 100:   model: string;
 101:   prompt: string;
 102:   duration: number;
 103:   aspectRatio: string;
 104:   resolution?: string;
 105:   references?: VideoReference[];
 106:   referenceUrls?: readonly string[];
 107: }): Record<string, unknown> {
 108:   // token.secure-skill.com is a separate gateway contract. It uses duration/ratio
 109:   // and image_urls, rather than the OAIRegBox data URL fields.
 110:   const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
 111:     model: input.model,
 112:     prompt: input.prompt,
 113:     duration: input.duration,
 114:     ratio: input.aspectRatio,
 115:     aspect_ratio: input.aspectRatio,
 116:   };
 117:   if (input.references?.length && !input.referenceUrls?.length) {
 118:     throw new Error("MiniMax 褰撳墠缃戝叧鐨勫弬鑰冨浘闇€瑕佸叕缃?HTTPS 鍥剧墖妗ユ帴锛屽綋鍓嶅伐浣滃彴鏆傛湭閰嶇疆");
 119:   }
 120:   if (input.referenceUrls?.length) {
 121:     if (input.referenceUrls.length > 5 || input.referenceUrls.some((url) => !/^https:\/\/[^\s]+$/i.test(url))) {
 122:       throw new Error("MiniMax 鍙傝€冨浘蹇呴』浣跨敤鍏綉 HTTPS 鍦板潃");
 123:     }
 124:     payload.image_urls = [...input.referenceUrls];
 125:   }
 126:   return payload;
 127: }

 129: function dataUrl(reference: VideoReference): string {
 130:   return `data:${reference.mimeType};base64,${reference.dataBase64}`;
 131: }

 133: function providerKey(envName: string): string {
 134:   const key = process.env[envName]?.trim();
 135:   if (!key) throw new Error(`瑙嗛渚涘簲鍟?API Key 鏈厤缃紙${envName}锛塦);
 136:   return key;
 137: }

 139: function providerUrl(raw: string, label: string): string {
 140:   let parsed: URL;
 141:   try {
 142:     parsed = new URL(raw);
 143:   } catch {
 144:     throw new Error(`${label}鎺ュ彛鍦板潃鏃犳晥`);
 145:   }
 146:   if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" || parsed.username || parsed.password) {
 147:     throw new Error(`${label}鎺ュ彛鍦板潃蹇呴』浣跨敤 HTTPS`);
 148:   }
 149:   return parsed.toString().replace(/\/$/, "");
 150: }

 152: async function readResponseBody(response: Response): Promise<string> {
 153:   const text = await response.text();
 154:   return text.slice(0, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
 155: }
 156: 
 157: async function fetchJson(
 158:   url: string,
 159:   init: RequestInit,
 160:   label: string,
 161: ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
 162:   const controller = new AbortController();
 163:   const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
 164:   try {
 165:     const response = await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: controller.signal, redirect: "error" });
 166:     const text = await readResponseBody(response);
 167:     if (!response.ok) {
 168:       throw new Error(`${label}璇锋眰澶辫触锛圚TTP ${response.status}锛?{extractErrorDetail(text)}`);
 169:     }
 170:     let payload: unknown;
 171:     try {
 172:       payload = JSON.parse(text);
 173:     } catch {
 174:       throw new Error(`${label}杩斿洖浜嗘棤鏁?JSON`);
 175:     }
 176:     if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || Array.isArray(payload)) {
 177:       throw new Error(`${label}杩斿洖鏍煎紡涓嶆纭甡);
 178:     }
 179:     return payload as Record<string, unknown>;
 180:   } catch (error) {
 181:     if (error instanceof Error && error.name === "AbortError") throw new Error(`${label}璇锋眰瓒呮椂`);
 182:     throw error;
 183:   } finally {
 184:     clearTimeout(timeout);
 185:   }
 186: }
 187: 
 188: function extractErrorDetail(text: string): string {
 189:   try {
 190:     const payload = JSON.parse(text) as { error?: unknown; message?: unknown; detail?: unknown };
 191:     const error = payload.error;
 192:     const value = error && typeof error === "object" && !Array.isArray(error)
 193:       ? (error as { message?: unknown; detail?: unknown }).message ?? (error as { detail?: unknown }).detail
 194:       : error ?? payload.message ?? payload.detail;
 195:     return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? `锛?{value.trim().slice(0, 500)}` : "";
 196:   } catch {
 197:     return "";
 198:   }
 199: }

 201: function taskIdFromResponse(response: Record<string, unknown>): string {
 202:   const taskId = response.task_id ?? response.id ?? response.video_id;
 203:   if (typeof taskId !== "string" && typeof taskId !== "number") throw new Error("瑙嗛渚涘簲鍟嗘病鏈夎繑鍥炰换鍔?ID");
 204:   return String(taskId);
 205: }
 206: 
 207: function statusFromResponse(response: Record<string, unknown>): string {
 208:   const direct = response.status ?? response.state;
 209:   if (typeof direct === "string") return direct.toLowerCase();
 210:   for (const value of [response.data, response.result, response.output]) {
 211:     if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)) {
 212:       const nested = statusFromResponse(value as Record<string, unknown>);
 213:       if (nested) return nested;
 214:     }
 215:   }
 216:   return "submitted";
 217: }
 218: 
 219: function progressFromResponse(response: Record<string, unknown>): number {
 220:   const value = response.progress;
 221:   if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(value)));
 222:   for (const nested of [response.data, response.result, response.output]) {
 223:     if (nested && typeof nested === "object" && !Array.isArray(nested)) {
 224:       const progress = progressFromResponse(nested as Record<string, unknown>);
 225:       if (progress > 0) return progress;
 226:     }
 227:   }
 228:   return 0;
 229: }

 231: function absoluteUrl(raw: string, baseUrl: string): string {
 232:   if (/^(https?:|data:)/i.test(raw)) return raw;
 233:   const parsed = new URL(baseUrl);
 234:   return `${parsed.origin}${raw.startsWith("/") ? raw : `/${raw}`}`;
 235: }

 237: export function videoUrlFromStatus(response: Record<string, unknown>, baseUrl: string): string {
 238:   for (const key of ["video_url", "content_url", "output_url", "download_url", "result_url", "url"]) {
 239:     const value = response[key];
 240:     if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) return absoluteUrl(value.trim(), baseUrl);
 241:   }
 242:   for (const value of [response.data, response.result, response.output]) {
 243:     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 244:       for (const item of value) {
 245:         if (item && typeof item === "object" && !Array.isArray(item)) {
 246:           const found = videoUrlFromStatus(item as Record<string, unknown>, baseUrl);
 247:           if (found) return found;
 248:         }
 249:         if (typeof item === "string" && /\.(mp4|webm|mov)(\?|$)/i.test(item)) return absoluteUrl(item, baseUrl);
 250:       }
 251:     } else if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 252:       const found = videoUrlFromStatus(value as Record<string, unknown>, baseUrl);
 253:       if (found) return found;
 254:     }
 255:   }
 256:   return "";
 257: }

 259: function headers(apiKey: string, contentType = "application/json"): HeadersInit {
 260:   return {
 261:     Accept: "application/json",
 262:     Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 263:     "Content-Type": contentType,
 264:     "User-Agent": "WorkspaceProduction/1.0",
 265:   };
 266: }

 268: function modelMatches(config: ReturnType<typeof getVideoSupplierConfig>, modelId: string): boolean {
 269:   return Boolean(config?.modelIds.includes(modelId));

 272: function configForRequest(input: VideoGenerationRequest) {
 273:   const config = getVideoSupplierConfig(input.supplierId);
 274:   if (!config) throw new Error("瑙嗛渚涘簲鍟嗕笉瀛樺湪");
 275:   if (!modelMatches(config, input.modelId)) throw new Error("瑙嗛渚涘簲鍟嗕笌妯″瀷涓嶅尮閰?);
 276:   if (config.provider === "seedance") throw new Error("Seedance 鐨勪緵搴斿晢鎺ュ彛濂戠害灏氭湭閰嶇疆");
 277:   return config;
 278: }

 280: export function validateVideoGenerationRequest(
 281:   input: VideoGenerationRequest,
 282:   options: { checkReferences?: boolean } = {},
 283: ) {
 284:   const config = configForRequest(input);
 285:   const capability = config.capabilities?.[input.modelId];
 286:   if (!capability) throw new Error("褰撳墠渚涘簲鍟嗗皻鏈厤缃妯″瀷鐨勮棰戝弬鏁板绾?);
 287:   validateVideoCapability(capability, {
 288:     duration: input.duration,
 289:     aspectRatio: input.aspectRatio,
 290:     resolution: input.resolution,
 291:     referenceCount: input.references.length,
 292:   }, options);
 293:   return config;
 294: }

 296: export async function submitVideo(input: VideoGenerationRequest): Promise<VideoProviderResponse> {
 297:   const config = validateVideoGenerationRequest(input);
 298:   const apiKey = providerKey(config.apiKeyEnv);
 299:   const baseUrl = providerUrl(process.env[config.baseUrlEnv] || config.defaultBaseUrl, config.label);
 300: 
 301:   if (config.provider === "oairegbox") {
 302:     const payload = buildOaiRegboxPayload({
 303:       model: config.model,
 304:       prompt: input.prompt,
 305:       duration: input.duration,
 306:       aspectRatio: input.aspectRatio,
 307:       references: input.references,
 308:     });
 309:     const response = await fetchJson(`${baseUrl}/videos`, {
 310:       method: "POST",
 311:       headers: headers(apiKey),
 312:       body: JSON.stringify(payload),
 313:     }, config.label);
 314:     return { providerTaskId: taskIdFromResponse(response), response };
 315:   }
 316: 
 317:   if (config.provider === "grok-video") {
 318:     const referenceUrls = await Promise.all(input.references.map((reference) => publishPublicReferenceImage(reference)));
 319:     const payload = buildGrokVideoPayload({
 320:       model: config.model,
 321:       prompt: input.prompt,
 322:       duration: input.duration,
 323:       aspectRatio: input.aspectRatio,
 324:       resolution: input.resolution,
 325:       referenceUrls,
 326:     });
 327:     const response = await fetchJson(`${baseUrl}/videos`, {
 328:       method: "POST",
 329:       headers: headers(apiKey),
 330:       body: JSON.stringify(payload),
 331:     }, config.label);
 332:     return { providerTaskId: taskIdFromResponse(response), response };
 333:   }
 334: 
 335:   if (input.references.length > 5) {
 336:     throw new Error("MiniMax 鍙傝€冨浘闇€瑕侀厤缃叕缃戝浘鐗囨ˉ鎺ュ湴鍧€鍚庢墠鑳芥彁浜?);
 337:   }
 338:   const referenceUrls = await Promise.all(input.references.map((reference) => publishPublicReferenceImage(reference)));
 339:   const payload = buildMiniMaxPayload({
 340:     model: config.model,
 341:     prompt: input.prompt,
 342:     duration: input.duration,
 343:     aspectRatio: input.aspectRatio,
 344:     resolution: input.resolution,
 345:     referenceUrls,
 346:   });
 347:   const response = await fetchJson(`${baseUrl}/videos`, {
 348:     method: "POST",
 349:     headers: headers(apiKey),
 350:     body: JSON.stringify(payload),
 351:   }, config.label);
 352:   return { providerTaskId: taskIdFromResponse(response), response };
 353: }

 355: export async function getVideoStatus(input: {
 356:   supplierId: string;
 357:   modelId: string;
 358:   providerTaskId: string;
 359: }): Promise<VideoStatusResponse> {
 360:   const config = getVideoSupplierConfig(input.supplierId);
 361:   if (!config || !modelMatches(config, input.modelId) || config.provider === "seedance") {
 362:     throw new Error("瑙嗛渚涘簲鍟嗛厤缃笉瀛樺湪");
 363:   }
 364:   const apiKey = providerKey(config.apiKeyEnv);
 365:   const baseUrl = providerUrl(process.env[config.baseUrlEnv] || config.defaultBaseUrl, config.label);
 366:   const taskId = encodeURIComponent(input.providerTaskId);
 367:   const path = `/videos/${taskId}`;
 368:   const response = await fetchJson(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
 369:     method: "GET",
 370:     headers: headers(apiKey),
 371:   }, config.label);
 372:   return { status: statusFromResponse(response), progress: progressFromResponse(response), response };
 373: }

 375: export function isVideoComplete(status: string): boolean {
 376:   return new Set(["completed", "complete", "succeeded", "success", "done"]).has(status.toLowerCase());
 377: }

  30: function sameOrigin(req: Request): boolean {
  31:   const origin = req.headers.get("origin");
  32:   if (!origin) return false;
  33:   try {
  34:     const requestUrl = new URL(req.url);
  35:     const host = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-host")?.split(",", 1)[0].trim() || req.headers.get("host") || requestUrl.host;
  36:     const protocol = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.split(",", 1)[0].trim() || requestUrl.protocol.slice(0, -1);
  37:     const originUrl = new URL(origin);
  38:     return originUrl.host === host && originUrl.protocol === `${protocol}:`;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return false;
  41:   }
  42: }

**Grok 上游请求格式**
当前“生产 > 生视频 > Grok”最终不是直接从浏览器请求 Grok，而是：

```text
浏览器生产板块
  -> POST /api/workspace/accounts/{accountId}/generate-video
  -> 写入 workspaceVideoTask 并 queueWorkspaceVideoTaskProcessing(task.id)
  -> 后台 worker 调 submitVideo(...)
  -> POST https://snumom.com/v1/videos
```

最终发给 Grok/snumom 的请求：

```http
POST https://snumom.com/v1/videos
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <GROK_VIDEO_API_KEY>
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: WorkspaceProduction/1.0
```

当前 `.env` 中 `GROK_VIDEO_BASE_URL=https://snumom.com/v1`，`GROK_VIDEO_API_KEY` 已配置但已脱敏；所以实际 endpoint 是：

```text
https://snumom.com/v1/videos
```

请求 body 基础结构：

```json
{
  "model": "grok-imagine-video-1.5（按次）",
  "prompt": "<最终视频提示词>",
  "duration": 10,
  "extra": {
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
    "resolution": "720p"
  }
}
```

如果选了 1 张参考图，会多一个顶层字段：

```json
{
  "model": "grok-imagine-video-1.5（按次）",
  "prompt": "<最终视频提示词>",
  "duration": 10,
  "extra": {
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
    "resolution": "720p"
  },
  "input_reference": "https://<公网桥接域名>/api/workspace/minimax-reference/<token>.jpg"
}
```

如果选了多张参考图，代码不用 `input_reference`，而是在 `extra.reference_images` 里传数组：

```json
{
  "model": "grok-imagine-video-1.5（按次）",
  "prompt": "<最终视频提示词>",
  "duration": 10,
  "extra": {
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "reference_images": [
      {
        "url": "https://<公网桥接域名>/api/workspace/minimax-reference/<token-1>.jpg",
        "role": "reference_image"
      },
      {
        "url": "https://<公网桥接域名>/api/workspace/minimax-reference/<token-2>.png",
        "role": "reference_image"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

没有看到 `stream: true` 或任何流式提交字段。服务端 `fetchJson` 是普通 `fetch`，然后 `response.text()` 读完整响应，再 `JSON.parse`。

**字段映射**
前端生产板块提交的是内部 API：

```json
{
  "supplierId": "grok-video",
  "modelId": "grok",
  "promptMode": "manual",
  "templateId": undefined,
  "prompt": "<手写提示词，或模板模式时为空>",
  "promptModel": "gpt-2999",
  "suffixEnabled": false,
  "duration": "10",
  "aspectRatio": "9:16",
  "resolution": "720p",
  "count": "1",
  "referenceAssetId": "<第一张参考图 id>",
  "referenceAssetIds": ["<参考图 id>"],
  "referenceRow": {
    "pid": "...",
    "title": "...",
    "description": "..."
  }
}
```

服务端 schema 会把这些字段校验/转换：

```text
supplierId -> 供应商配置 id，Grok 必须是 grok-video
modelId -> 视频模型 id，Grok 必须是 grok
duration -> number，Grok 能力范围 6-30
aspectRatio -> "9:16" | "16:9" | "1:1"
resolution -> "480p" | "720p"
count -> 1-4，只影响创建多少个本地任务，不进入单次 Grok 上游请求
referenceAssetIds -> 本地图片读成 base64，再发布成公网 HTTPS URL
prompt/finalPrompt -> 上游 body.prompt
```

参考图不是以 base64 传给 Grok。Grok 分支会先执行 `publishPublicReferenceImage(reference)`，生成可访问的 HTTPS 图片 URL，然后放进 `input_reference` 或 `extra.reference_images`。

**状态查询格式**
任务提交成功后，后续轮询状态也是 Grok/snumom 上游：

```http
GET https://snumom.com/v1/videos/{providerTaskId}
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <GROK_VIDEO_API_KEY>
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: WorkspaceProduction/1.0
```

下载时如果状态响应里没有直接给视频 URL，会 fallback 到：

```http
GET https://snumom.com/v1/videos/{providerTaskId}/content
Accept: video/mp4,video/*,*/*
Authorization: Bearer <GROK_VIDEO_API_KEY>
```

  253:     def scan_gallery_source(self, *, root_directory: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
  254:         """Recursively list PID-named images under a JSpace directory.
  255: 
  256:         The local desktop client exposes a paginated JSON file-list endpoint;

  274:                     if isinstance(data.get(key), list):

  277: 
  278:         def is_directory(item: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:

  332:         def walk(client: httpx.Client, directory: str) -> None:
  333:             nonlocal scanned_dirs, scanned_files

  133: class PersistentWorkflowScheduler:
  134:     def __init__(
  135:         self,
  136:         repository: BatchRepository,
  137:         settings_service: SettingsService,
  138:         runner: ItemRunner | None = None,
  139:         terminal_handler: Callable[[str], Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None = None,
  140:     ) -> None:
  141:         self.repository = repository
  142:         self.settings_service = settings_service
  143:         self.runner = runner or LegacyAdapterRunner()
  144:         self.terminal_handler = terminal_handler
  145:         self._threads: dict[str, threading.Thread] = {}
  146:         self._profile_locks: dict[str, threading.Lock] = {}
  147:         self._closed_resource_batches: set[str] = set()
  148:         self._handled_terminal_batches: set[str] = set()
  149:         self._lock = threading.RLock()
  150:         self._stopping = threading.Event()
  151: 
  152:     def start(self, batch_id: str) -> bool:
  153:         with self._lock:
  154:             if self._stopping.is_set():
  155:                 return False
  156:             existing = self._threads.get(batch_id)
  157:             if existing and existing.is_alive():
  158:                 return True
  159:             thread = threading.Thread(
  160:                 target=self._run_batch,
  161:                 args=(batch_id,),
  162:                 name=f"workflow-{batch_id[:8]}",
  163:                 daemon=True,
  164:             )
  165:             self._threads = {**self._threads, batch_id: thread}
  166:             thread.start()
  167:         return True
  168: 
  169:     def pause(self, batch_id: str) -> None:
  170:         return None
  171: 
  172:     def resume(self, batch_id: str) -> bool:
  173:         return self.start(batch_id)
  174: 
  175:     def cancel(self, batch_id: str) -> None:
  176:         return None
  177: 
  178:     def wait(self, batch_id: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> bool:
  179:         with self._lock:
  180:             thread = self._threads.get(batch_id)
  181:         if thread is None:
  182:             return True
  183:         thread.join(timeout)
  184:         finished = not thread.is_alive()
  185:         if finished:
  186:             with self._lock:
  187:                 if self._threads.get(batch_id) is thread:
  188:                     self._threads = {
  189:                         key: value
  190:                         for key, value in self._threads.items()
  191:                         if key != batch_id
  192:                     }
  193:         return finished
  194: 
  195:     def shutdown(self, timeout: float = 30) -> bool:
  196:         deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
  197:         with self._lock:
  198:             self._stopping.set()
  199:             active = tuple(
  200:                 (batch_id, thread)
  201:                 for batch_id, thread in self._threads.items()
  202:                 if thread.is_alive()
  203:             )
  204:         for batch_id, _thread in active:
  205:             try:
  206:                 status = self.repository.get_batch(batch_id)["status"]
  207:                 if status in {"running", "paused"}:
  208:                     self.repository.transition(batch_id, "cancel")
  209:             except (NotFoundError, InvalidTransitionError):
  210:                 continue
  211:         for _batch_id, thread in active:
  212:             remaining = max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic())
  213:             thread.join(remaining)
  214:         return all(not thread.is_alive() for _batch_id, thread in active)

  216:     def is_stopping(self) -> bool:
  217:         return self._stopping.is_set()

  222:                 batch_id for batch_id, thread in self._threads.items() if thread.is_alive()

   83: def _mapping_text(mapping: Mapping[str, Any], key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
   84:     value = mapping.get(key, default)
   85:     return str(value if value is not None else default).strip()

   88: def _validate_identifiers(context: WorkflowContext) -> tuple[str, str]:
   89:     batch_id = _mapping_text(context.batch, "id")
   90:     pid = _mapping_text(context.item, "pid")
   91:     if not _SAFE_COMPONENT_PATTERN.fullmatch(batch_id):
   92:         raise WorkflowExecutionError("invalid_batch_id", "The batch identifier is invalid.")
   93:     if not _PID_PATTERN.fullmatch(pid):
   94:         raise WorkflowExecutionError(
   95:             "invalid_pid",
   96:             f"The product PID must contain {PID_MIN_LENGTH} to {PID_MAX_LENGTH} digits.",
   97:         )
   98:     return batch_id, pid

  101: def _check_control(context: WorkflowContext) -> None:
  102:     if context.should_cancel():

  104:     if context.wait_if_paused() is False or context.should_cancel():
  105:         raise WorkflowCancelled()

  112: def _redact(context: WorkflowContext, value: object) -> str:

  115:         if secret_value:

  459:     destination: Path,
  460:     item_root: Path,
  461:     source_root: Path | None = None,
  462: ) -> None:
  463:     temporary = item_root / f".publish-{destination.name}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
  464:     temporary.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
  465:     try:
  466:         for source in source_files:
  467:             relative_path = source.relative_to(source_root) if source_root is not None else Path(source.name)
  468:             target = temporary / relative_path
  469:             target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  470:             shutil.copy2(source, target)
  471:         _archive_existing(destination, item_root)
  472:         temporary.replace(destination)
  473:     except Exception:
  474:         if temporary.exists():
  475:             shutil.rmtree(temporary)
  476:         raise

  258:     def existing_pids(self, pids: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
  259:         return set(self.lookup_by_pids(pids))
  260: 
  261:     def lookup_by_pids(
  262:         self, pids: Iterable[str], *, chunk_size: int = 500
  263:     ) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
  264:         values = list(dict.fromkeys(str(pid).strip() for pid in pids if str(pid).strip()))
  265:         if not values:
  266:             return {}
  267:         result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  268:         safe_chunk_size = max(1, min(int(chunk_size), 500))
  269:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  270:             for start in range(0, len(values), safe_chunk_size):
  271:                 chunk = values[start : start + safe_chunk_size]
  272:                 placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in chunk)
  273:                 rows = connection.execute(
  274:                     f"{_GALLERY_SELECT} WHERE g.pid IN ({placeholders})", chunk
  275:                 ).fetchall()
  276:                 for row in rows:
  277:                     item = _decode_row(row)
  278:                     result[str(item["pid"])] = item
  279:         return result

  281:     def list_items(
  282:         self,
  283:         *,
  284:         query: str = "",
  285:         category: str | None = None,
  286:         membership: str | None = None,
  287:         limit: int = 100,
  288:         offset: int = 0,
  289:     ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:
  290:         normalized_query = str(query or "").strip()
  291:         normalized_category = str(category or "").strip().casefold()
  292:         if normalized_category and normalized_category not in {"cap", "tap", "unknown"}:
  293:             raise ValueError("gallery category must be cap, tap, or unknown")
  294:         normalized_membership = str(membership or "").strip().casefold()
  295:         if normalized_membership and normalized_membership not in {
  296:             "tap", "cap", "both", "neither", "pending", "error"
  297:         }:
  298:             raise ValueError("gallery membership filter is invalid")
  299:         clauses: list[str] = []
  300:         values: list[Any] = []
  301:         if normalized_query:
  302:             clauses.append(
  303:                 "(g.pid LIKE ? OR COALESCE(g.source_path, '') LIKE ? "
  304:                 "OR COALESCE(g.artifact_path, '') LIKE ?)"
  305:             )
  306:             pattern = f"%{normalized_query}%"
  307:             values.extend([pattern, pattern, pattern])
  308:         if normalized_category:
  309:             clauses.append("g.category = ?")
  310:             values.append(normalized_category)
  311:         membership_clauses = {
  312:             "tap": "tap.is_matched = 1",
  313:             "cap": "cap.is_matched = 1",
  314:             "both": "tap.is_matched = 1 AND cap.is_matched = 1",
  315:             "neither": (
  316:                 "tap.last_success_at IS NOT NULL AND cap.last_success_at IS NOT NULL "
  317:                 "AND tap.is_matched = 0 AND cap.is_matched = 0"
  318:             ),
  319:             "pending": (
  320:                 "(tap.last_success_at IS NULL OR cap.last_success_at IS NULL) "
  321:                 "AND COALESCE(tap.last_error_code, cap.last_error_code) IS NULL"
  322:             ),
  323:             "error": (
  324:                 "(tap.last_success_at IS NULL OR cap.last_success_at IS NULL) "
  325:                 "AND COALESCE(tap.last_error_code, cap.last_error_code) IS NOT NULL"
  326:             ),
  327:         }
  328:         if normalized_membership:
  329:             clauses.append(membership_clauses[normalized_membership])
  330:         where = f" WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
  331:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  332:             count_sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ({_GALLERY_SELECT}{where}) matched_gallery"
  333:             total = int(connection.execute(count_sql, values).fetchone()[0])
  334:             rows = connection.execute(
  335:                 f"{_GALLERY_SELECT}{where} ORDER BY g.pid LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
  336:                 [*values, int(limit), int(offset)],
  337:             ).fetchall()
  338:         return [_decode_row(row) for row in rows], total
  339: 
  340:     def get_items(self, pids: Iterable[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

  342:         items_by_pid = self.lookup_by_pids(values)
  343:         return [items_by_pid[pid] for pid in values if pid in items_by_pid]

  496:     def create_batch(
  497:         self,
  498:         *,
  499:         name: str,
  500:         pids: Iterable[str],
  501:         category_mode: str,
  502:         worker_count: int,
  503:         profile_ids: Iterable[str],
  504:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  505:         batch_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
  506:         now = utc_now()
  507:         input_pids = list(dict.fromkeys(str(pid).strip() for pid in pids))
  508:         skipped_gallery_pids = sorted(self.gallery_repository.existing_pids(input_pids))
  509:         unique_pids = [pid for pid in input_pids if pid not in set(skipped_gallery_pids)]
  510:         if not unique_pids:
  511:             raise AllPidsInGalleryError(skipped_gallery_pids)
  512:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  513:             normalized_name = str(name or "").strip()
  514:             if _needs_auto_batch_name(normalized_name):
  515:                 normalized_name = self._next_auto_batch_name(
  516:                     connection,
  517:                     pid_count=len(unique_pids),
  518:                     date_label=datetime.now(UTC).astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
  519:                 )
  520:             connection.execute(
  521:                 """
  522:                 INSERT INTO batches(
  523:                     id, name, category_mode, status, worker_count,
  524:                     profile_ids_json, created_at, updated_at,
  525:                     input_pids_json, skipped_gallery_pids_json
  526:                 ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  527:                 """,
  528:                 (
  529:                     batch_id,
  530:                     normalized_name,
  531:                     category_mode,
  532:                     worker_count,
  533:                     json.dumps(list(profile_ids), ensure_ascii=False),
  534:                     now,
  535:                     now,
  536:                     json.dumps(input_pids, ensure_ascii=False),
  537:                     json.dumps(skipped_gallery_pids, ensure_ascii=False),
  538:                 ),
  539:             )
  540:             connection.executemany(
  541:                 """
  542:                 INSERT INTO batch_items(
  543:                     id, batch_id, pid, position, status, stage, created_at, updated_at
  544:                 ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', 'pending', ?, ?)
  545:                 """,
  546:                 [
  547:                     (str(uuid.uuid4()), batch_id, pid, position, now, now)
  548:                     for position, pid in enumerate(unique_pids)
  549:                 ],
  550:             )
  551:             self._insert_event(
  552:                 connection,
  553:                 batch_id=batch_id,
  554:                 event_type="batch.created",
  555:                 message=f"鎵规宸插垱寤猴紝鍏?{len(unique_pids)} 涓?PID",
  556:                 data={"total": len(unique_pids)},
  557:             )
  558:             if skipped_gallery_pids:
  559:                 self._insert_event(
  560:                     connection,
  561:                     batch_id=batch_id,
  562:                     event_type="batch.gallery_skipped",
  563:                     message=f"{len(skipped_gallery_pids)} PID already exist in gallery",
  564:                     data={"skipped_pids": skipped_gallery_pids, "skipped_count": len(skipped_gallery_pids)},
  565:                 )
  566:         created = self.get_batch(batch_id)
  567:         return {
  568:             **created,
  569:             "input_pids": input_pids,
  570:             "skipped_gallery_pids": skipped_gallery_pids,
  571:             "skipped_count": len(skipped_gallery_pids),
  572:         }

  574:     @staticmethod
  575:     def _next_auto_batch_name(
  576:         connection: sqlite3.Connection, *, pid_count: int, date_label: str
  577:     ) -> str:
  578:         prefix = f"{date_label}_{pid_count}PID_"
  579:         rows = connection.execute(
  580:             "SELECT name FROM batches WHERE name LIKE ?", (f"{date_label}_%",)
  581:         ).fetchall()
  582:         existing = {str(row[0]) for row in rows}
  583:         sequence = 1
  584:         while f"{prefix}{sequence}" in existing:
  585:             sequence += 1
  586:         return f"{prefix}{sequence}"
  587: 
  588:     def repair_batch_names(self) -> int:
  589:         """Normalize generated names while preserving user-defined names."""
  590:         repaired = 0
  591:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  592:             rows = connection.execute(
  593:                 """
  594:                 SELECT b.id, b.name, b.created_at, COUNT(i.id) AS pid_count
  595:                 FROM batches b
  596:                 LEFT JOIN batch_items i ON i.batch_id = b.id
  597:                 GROUP BY b.id
  598:                 ORDER BY b.created_at ASC, b.id ASC
  599:                 """
  600:             ).fetchall()
  601:             for row in rows:
  602:                 current_name = str(row["name"] or "")
  603:                 legacy_parts = _legacy_chinese_auto_name_parts(current_name)
  604:                 if legacy_parts is None and not _needs_auto_batch_name(current_name):
  605:                     continue
  606:                 created_at = str(row["created_at"] or "")
  607:                 if legacy_parts is not None:
  608:                     date_label, pid_count, sequence = legacy_parts
  609:                     candidate = f"{date_label}_{pid_count}PID_{sequence}"
  610:                     existing = connection.execute(
  611:                         "SELECT 1 FROM batches WHERE name = ? AND id != ? LIMIT 1",
  612:                         (candidate, row["id"]),
  613:                     ).fetchone()
  614:                     replacement = candidate if existing is None else self._next_auto_batch_name(
  615:                         connection, pid_count=pid_count, date_label=date_label
  616:                     )
  617:                 else:
  618:                     date_label = created_at[:10]
  619:                     if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", date_label):
  620:                         date_label = datetime.now(UTC).astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
  621:                     replacement = self._next_auto_batch_name(
  622:                         connection,
  623:                         pid_count=int(row["pid_count"] or 0),
  624:                         date_label=date_label,
  625:                     )
  626:                 connection.execute(
  627:                     "UPDATE batches SET name = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
  628:                     (replacement, utc_now(), row["id"]),
  629:                 )
  647:                 (limit, offset),
  648:             ).fetchall()
  649:         return [_decode_row(row) for row in rows]

  669:     def list_events(
  670:         self, batch_id: str, *, after_id: int = 0, limit: int = 500
  671:     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

  679:                 """,
  680:                 (batch_id, after_id, limit),
  681:             ).fetchall()

  705:         return _decode_row(row)

  707:     def transition(self, batch_id: str, action: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
  708:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  709:             batch_row = connection.execute(
  710:                 "SELECT * FROM batches WHERE id = ?", (batch_id,)
  711:             ).fetchone()
  712:             if batch_row is None:
  713:                 raise NotFoundError("鎵规涓嶅瓨鍦?)
  714:             current_status = batch_row["status"]
  715:             if action == "retry-failed":
  716:                 return self._retry_failed(connection, batch_id, current_status)
  717:             next_status = self._TRANSITIONS.get(action, {}).get(current_status)
  718:             if next_status is None:
  719:                 raise InvalidTransitionError(
  720:                     f"鎵规澶勪簬 {current_status} 鐘舵€侊紝涓嶈兘鎵ц {action}"
  721:                 )
  722:             now = utc_now()
  723:             started_at = now if action == "start" else batch_row["started_at"]
  724:             finished_at = now if next_status == "cancelled" else None
  725:             connection.execute(
  726:                 """
  727:                 UPDATE batches
  728:                 SET status = ?, updated_at = ?, started_at = ?, finished_at = ?
  729:                 WHERE id = ?
  730:                 """,
  731:                 (next_status, now, started_at, finished_at, batch_id),
  732:             )
  733:             if next_status == "cancelled":
  734:                 connection.execute(
  735:                     """
  736:                     UPDATE batch_items
  737:                     SET status = 'cancelled', stage = 'cancelled', updated_at = ?
  738:                     WHERE batch_id = ? AND status IN ('pending', 'running')
  739:                     """,
  740:                     (now, batch_id),
  741:                 )
  742:             self._insert_event(
  743:                 connection,
  744:                 batch_id=batch_id,
  745:                 event_type=f"batch.{next_status}",
  746:                 message={
  747:                     "running": "鎵规宸插紑濮嬫垨缁х画",
  748:                     "paused": "鎵规宸叉殏鍋?,
  749:                     "cancelled": "鎵规宸插彇娑?,
  750:                 }[next_status],
  751:                 data={"previous_status": current_status, "action": action},
  752:             )
  753:         return self.get_batch(batch_id)

  934:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  935:             counts = connection.execute(

  939:                 """,

  943:             current = connection.execute(

  945:             ).fetchone()

  951:                 return self.get_batch(batch_id)

   45: _CHINESE_DIGITS = {
   46:     "一": 1,
   47:     "二": 2,
   48:     "三": 3,
   49:     "四": 4,
   50:     "五": 5,

   58: def _legacy_chinese_sequence_value(value: str) -> int | None:
   59:     if value in _CHINESE_DIGITS:
   60:         return _CHINESE_DIGITS[value]
   61:     if value == "十":
   62:         return 10
   63:     if value.startswith("十"):
   64:         ones = _CHINESE_DIGITS.get(value[1:])
   65:         return 10 + ones if ones is not None else None
   66:     if "十" not in value:
   67:         return None
   68:     tens_text, ones_text = value.split("十", 1)
   69:     tens = _CHINESE_DIGITS.get(tens_text)
   70:     if tens is None:
   71:         return None
   72:     ones = _CHINESE_DIGITS.get(ones_text, 0) if ones_text else 0
   73:     return tens * 10 + ones if ones_text == "" or ones else None

   86: def _legacy_chinese_auto_name_parts(name: str) -> tuple[str, int, int] | None:
   87:     match = _LEGACY_CHINESE_AUTO_NAME_RE.fullmatch(name.strip())
   88:     if match is None:
   89:         return None
   90:     sequence = _legacy_chinese_sequence_value(match.group("sequence"))
   91:     if sequence is None:
   92:         return None
   93:     return match.group("date"), int(match.group("pids")), sequence

   96: def _decode_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict[str, Any]:
   97:     result = dict(row)
   98:     for source, target, default in (
   99:         ("profile_ids_json", "profile_ids", []),
  100:         ("input_pids_json", "input_pids", []),
  101:         ("skipped_gallery_pids_json", "skipped_gallery_pids", []),
  102:         ("metadata_json", "metadata", {}),
  103:         ("data_json", "data", {}),
  104:         ("manifest_json", "manifest", {}),
  105:     ):
  106:         if source in result:
  107:             raw = result.pop(source)
  108:             try:
  109:                 result[target] = json.loads(raw)
  110:             except (TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
  111:                 result[target] = default
  112:     if "confirmed" in result:
  113:         result["confirmed"] = bool(result["confirmed"])
  114:     if "tap_is_matched" in result or "cap_is_matched" in result:
  115:         success_times: list[str] = []
  116:         source_errors: list[str] = []
  117:         for source in ("tap", "cap"):
  118:             matched = result.pop(f"{source}_is_matched", None)
  119:             rate_bps = result.pop(f"{source}_commission_rate_bps", None)
  120:             last_success = result.pop(f"{source}_last_success_at", None)
  121:             error_code = result.pop(f"{source}_last_error_code", None)
  122:             result[f"{source}_matched"] = bool(matched) if matched is not None else None
  123:             result[f"{source}_commission_rate"] = (
  124:                 int(rate_bps) / 100 if rate_bps is not None else None
  125:             )
  126:             if last_success:
  127:                 success_times.append(str(last_success))
  128:             if error_code and not last_success:
  129:                 source_errors.append(source)
  130:         if len(success_times) == 2:
  131:             result["membership_status"] = (
  132:                 "matched"
  133:                 if result["tap_matched"] or result["cap_matched"]
  134:                 else "unmatched"
  135:             )
  136:         elif source_errors:
  137:             result["membership_status"] = "error"
  138:         else:
  139:             result["membership_status"] = "pending"
  140:         result["membership_checked_at"] = max(success_times) if success_times else None
  141:     return result

  154: FROM gallery_items g
  155: LEFT JOIN gallery_source_matches tap ON tap.pid = g.pid AND tap.source = 'tap'

  213:     def import_items(self, items: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> int:
  214:         normalized_by_pid: dict[str, tuple[str, str, str | None, str | None, str, str, str]] = {}
  215:         for item in items:
  216:             pid = str(item.get("pid", "")).strip()
  217:             category = str(item.get("category") or "unknown").strip().casefold()
  218:             if not pid:
  219:                 raise ValueError("gallery PID cannot be empty")
  220:             if category not in {"cap", "tap", "unknown"}:
  221:                 raise ValueError("gallery category must be cap, tap, or unknown")
  222:             previous = normalized_by_pid.get(pid)
  223:             if previous and previous[1] in {"cap", "tap"} and category == "unknown":
  224:                 continue
  225:             now = utc_now()
  226:             normalized_by_pid[pid] = (
  227:                 pid,
  228:                 category,
  229:                 item.get("source_path"),
  230:                 canonical_gallery_artifact_path(
  231:                     pid, item.get("artifact_path"), item.get("source_path")
  232:                 ),
  233:                 now,
  234:                 now,
  235:                 now,
  236:             )
  237:         normalized = list(normalized_by_pid.values())
  238:         if not normalized:
  239:             return 0
  240:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  241:             connection.executemany(
  242:                 """
  243:                 INSERT INTO gallery_items(
  244:                     pid, category, source_path, artifact_path, created_at, updated_at, last_seen_at
  245:                 ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  246:                 ON CONFLICT(pid) DO UPDATE SET
  247:                     category = CASE WHEN excluded.category = 'unknown'
  248:                                     THEN gallery_items.category ELSE excluded.category END,
  249:                     source_path = COALESCE(excluded.source_path, gallery_items.source_path),
  250:                     artifact_path = COALESCE(excluded.artifact_path, gallery_items.artifact_path),
  251:                     updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
  252:                     last_seen_at = excluded.last_seen_at
  253:                 """,
  254:                 normalized,
  255:             )
  256:         return len(normalized)

  258:     def existing_pids(self, pids: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
  259:         return set(self.lookup_by_pids(pids))
  260: 
  261:     def lookup_by_pids(
  262:         self, pids: Iterable[str], *, chunk_size: int = 500
  263:     ) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
  264:         values = list(dict.fromkeys(str(pid).strip() for pid in pids if str(pid).strip()))
  265:         if not values:
  266:             return {}
  267:         result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  268:         safe_chunk_size = max(1, min(int(chunk_size), 500))
  269:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  270:             for start in range(0, len(values), safe_chunk_size):
  271:                 chunk = values[start : start + safe_chunk_size]
  272:                 placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in chunk)
  273:                 rows = connection.execute(
  274:                     f"{_GALLERY_SELECT} WHERE g.pid IN ({placeholders})", chunk
  275:                 ).fetchall()
  276:                 for row in rows:
  277:                     item = _decode_row(row)
  278:                     result[str(item["pid"])] = item
  279:         return result

  281:     def list_items(
  282:         self,
  283:         *,
  284:         query: str = "",
  285:         category: str | None = None,
  286:         membership: str | None = None,
  287:         limit: int = 100,
  288:         offset: int = 0,
  289:     ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:
  290:         normalized_query = str(query or "").strip()
  291:         normalized_category = str(category or "").strip().casefold()
  292:         if normalized_category and normalized_category not in {"cap", "tap", "unknown"}:
  293:             raise ValueError("gallery category must be cap, tap, or unknown")
  294:         normalized_membership = str(membership or "").strip().casefold()
  295:         if normalized_membership and normalized_membership not in {
  296:             "tap", "cap", "both", "neither", "pending", "error"
  297:         }:
  298:             raise ValueError("gallery membership filter is invalid")
  299:         clauses: list[str] = []
  300:         values: list[Any] = []
  301:         if normalized_query:
  302:             clauses.append(
  303:                 "(g.pid LIKE ? OR COALESCE(g.source_path, '') LIKE ? "
  304:                 "OR COALESCE(g.artifact_path, '') LIKE ?)"
  305:             )
  306:             pattern = f"%{normalized_query}%"
  307:             values.extend([pattern, pattern, pattern])
  308:         if normalized_category:
  309:             clauses.append("g.category = ?")
  310:             values.append(normalized_category)
  311:         membership_clauses = {
  312:             "tap": "tap.is_matched = 1",
  313:             "cap": "cap.is_matched = 1",
  314:             "both": "tap.is_matched = 1 AND cap.is_matched = 1",
  315:             "neither": (
  316:                 "tap.last_success_at IS NOT NULL AND cap.last_success_at IS NOT NULL "
  317:                 "AND tap.is_matched = 0 AND cap.is_matched = 0"
  318:             ),
  319:             "pending": (
  320:                 "(tap.last_success_at IS NULL OR cap.last_success_at IS NULL) "
  321:                 "AND COALESCE(tap.last_error_code, cap.last_error_code) IS NULL"
  322:             ),
  323:             "error": (
  324:                 "(tap.last_success_at IS NULL OR cap.last_success_at IS NULL) "
  325:                 "AND COALESCE(tap.last_error_code, cap.last_error_code) IS NOT NULL"
  326:             ),
  327:         }
  328:         if normalized_membership:
  329:             clauses.append(membership_clauses[normalized_membership])
  330:         where = f" WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
  331:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  332:             count_sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ({_GALLERY_SELECT}{where}) matched_gallery"
  333:             total = int(connection.execute(count_sql, values).fetchone()[0])
  334:             rows = connection.execute(
  335:                 f"{_GALLERY_SELECT}{where} ORDER BY g.pid LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
  336:                 [*values, int(limit), int(offset)],
  337:             ).fetchall()
  338:         return [_decode_row(row) for row in rows], total

  363:     def stats(self) -> dict[str, int]:
  364:         with self.database.connect() as connection:

  366:                 f"""
  367:                 SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,

  505:         batch_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
  506:         now = utc_now()
  507:         input_pids = list(dict.fromkeys(str(pid).strip() for pid in pids))
  508:         skipped_gallery_pids = sorted(self.gallery_repository.existing_pids(input_pids))
  509:         unique_pids = [pid for pid in input_pids if pid not in set(skipped_gallery_pids)]
  510:         if not unique_pids:
  511:             raise AllPidsInGalleryError(skipped_gallery_pids)
  512:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  513:             normalized_name = str(name or "").strip()
  514:             if _needs_auto_batch_name(normalized_name):
  515:                 normalized_name = self._next_auto_batch_name(
  516:                     connection,
  517:                     pid_count=len(unique_pids),
  518:                     date_label=datetime.now(UTC).astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
  519:                 )
  520:             connection.execute(
  521:                 """
  522:                 INSERT INTO batches(
  523:                     id, name, category_mode, status, worker_count,
  524:                     profile_ids_json, created_at, updated_at,
  525:                     input_pids_json, skipped_gallery_pids_json
  526:                 ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  527:                 """,
  528:                 (
  529:                     batch_id,
  530:                     normalized_name,
  531:                     category_mode,
  532:                     worker_count,
  533:                     json.dumps(list(profile_ids), ensure_ascii=False),
  534:                     now,
  535:                     now,
  536:                     json.dumps(input_pids, ensure_ascii=False),
  537:                     json.dumps(skipped_gallery_pids, ensure_ascii=False),
  538:                 ),
  539:             )
  540:             connection.executemany(
  541:                 """
  542:                 INSERT INTO batch_items(
  543:                     id, batch_id, pid, position, status, stage, created_at, updated_at
  544:                 ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', 'pending', ?, ?)
  545:                 """,
  546:                 [
  547:                     (str(uuid.uuid4()), batch_id, pid, position, now, now)
  548:                     for position, pid in enumerate(unique_pids)
  549:                 ],
  550:             )
  551:             self._insert_event(
  552:                 connection,
  553:                 batch_id=batch_id,
  554:                 event_type="batch.created",
  555:                 message=f"批次已创建，共 {len(unique_pids)} 个 PID",
  556:                 data={"total": len(unique_pids)},
  557:             )
  558:             if skipped_gallery_pids:
  559:                 self._insert_event(
  560:                     connection,
  561:                     batch_id=batch_id,
  562:                     event_type="batch.gallery_skipped",
  563:                     message=f"{len(skipped_gallery_pids)} PID already exist in gallery",
  564:                     data={"skipped_pids": skipped_gallery_pids, "skipped_count": len(skipped_gallery_pids)},
  565:                 )
  566:         created = self.get_batch(batch_id)
  567:         return {
  568:             **created,
  569:             "input_pids": input_pids,
  570:             "skipped_gallery_pids": skipped_gallery_pids,
  571:             "skipped_count": len(skipped_gallery_pids),
  572:         }
  573: 
  574:     @staticmethod
  575:     def _next_auto_batch_name(
  576:         connection: sqlite3.Connection, *, pid_count: int, date_label: str
  577:     ) -> str:
  578:         prefix = f"{date_label}_{pid_count}PID_"
  579:         rows = connection.execute(
  580:             "SELECT name FROM batches WHERE name LIKE ?", (f"{date_label}_%",)
  581:         ).fetchall()
  582:         existing = {str(row[0]) for row in rows}
  583:         sequence = 1
  584:         while f"{prefix}{sequence}" in existing:
  585:             sequence += 1
  586:         return f"{prefix}{sequence}"
  587: 
  588:     def repair_batch_names(self) -> int:
  589:         """Normalize generated names while preserving user-defined names."""
  590:         repaired = 0
  591:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  592:             rows = connection.execute(
  593:                 """
  594:                 SELECT b.id, b.name, b.created_at, COUNT(i.id) AS pid_count
  595:                 FROM batches b
  596:                 LEFT JOIN batch_items i ON i.batch_id = b.id
  597:                 GROUP BY b.id
  598:                 ORDER BY b.created_at ASC, b.id ASC
  599:                 """
  600:             ).fetchall()
  601:             for row in rows:
  602:                 current_name = str(row["name"] or "")
  603:                 legacy_parts = _legacy_chinese_auto_name_parts(current_name)
  604:                 if legacy_parts is None and not _needs_auto_batch_name(current_name):
  605:                     continue
  606:                 created_at = str(row["created_at"] or "")
  607:                 if legacy_parts is not None:
  608:                     date_label, pid_count, sequence = legacy_parts
  609:                     candidate = f"{date_label}_{pid_count}PID_{sequence}"
  610:                     existing = connection.execute(
  611:                         "SELECT 1 FROM batches WHERE name = ? AND id != ? LIMIT 1",
  612:                         (candidate, row["id"]),
  613:                     ).fetchone()
  614:                     replacement = candidate if existing is None else self._next_auto_batch_name(
  615:                         connection, pid_count=pid_count, date_label=date_label
  616:                     )
  617:                 else:
  618:                     date_label = created_at[:10]
  619:                     if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", date_label):
  620:                         date_label = datetime.now(UTC).astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
  621:                     replacement = self._next_auto_batch_name(
  622:                         connection,
  623:                         pid_count=int(row["pid_count"] or 0),
  624:                         date_label=date_label,
  625:                     )
  626:                 connection.execute(
  627:                     "UPDATE batches SET name = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
  628:                     (replacement, utc_now(), row["id"]),
  629:                 )
  630:                 repaired += 1
  631:         return repaired
  632: 
  633:     def list_batches(self, *, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  634:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  635:             rows = connection.execute(
  636:                 """
  637:                 SELECT b.*,
  638:                        COUNT(i.id) AS total,
  639:                        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS succeeded,
  640:                        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed
  641:                 FROM batches b
  642:                 LEFT JOIN batch_items i ON i.batch_id = b.id
  643:                 GROUP BY b.id
  644:                 ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
  645:                 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
  646:                 """,
  647:                 (limit, offset),
  648:             ).fetchall()
  649:         return [_decode_row(row) for row in rows]

  655:             ).fetchone()

  684:     def add_event(
  685:         self,
  686:         batch_id: str,
  687:         *,
  688:         event_type: str,
  689:         message: str,
  690:         level: str = "info",
  691:         item_id: str | None = None,
  692:         data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
  693:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  694:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  695:             event_id = self._insert_event(
  696:                 connection,
  697:                 batch_id=batch_id,
  698:                 event_type=event_type,
  699:                 message=message,
  700:                 level=level,
  701:                 item_id=item_id,
  702:                 data=data,
  703:             )
  704:             row = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = ?", (event_id,)).fetchone()
  705:         return _decode_row(row)

  707:     def transition(self, batch_id: str, action: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
  708:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  709:             batch_row = connection.execute(
  710:                 "SELECT * FROM batches WHERE id = ?", (batch_id,)
  711:             ).fetchone()
  712:             if batch_row is None:
  713:                 raise NotFoundError("批次不存在")
  714:             current_status = batch_row["status"]
  715:             if action == "retry-failed":
  716:                 return self._retry_failed(connection, batch_id, current_status)
  717:             next_status = self._TRANSITIONS.get(action, {}).get(current_status)
  718:             if next_status is None:
  719:                 raise InvalidTransitionError(
  720:                     f"批次处于 {current_status} 状态，不能执行 {action}"
  721:                 )
  722:             now = utc_now()
  723:             started_at = now if action == "start" else batch_row["started_at"]
  724:             finished_at = now if next_status == "cancelled" else None
  725:             connection.execute(
  726:                 """
  727:                 UPDATE batches
  728:                 SET status = ?, updated_at = ?, started_at = ?, finished_at = ?
  729:                 WHERE id = ?
  730:                 """,
  731:                 (next_status, now, started_at, finished_at, batch_id),
  732:             )
  733:             if next_status == "cancelled":
  734:                 connection.execute(
  735:                     """
  736:                     UPDATE batch_items
  737:                     SET status = 'cancelled', stage = 'cancelled', updated_at = ?
  738:                     WHERE batch_id = ? AND status IN ('pending', 'running')
  739:                     """,
  740:                     (now, batch_id),
  741:                 )
  742:             self._insert_event(
  743:                 connection,
  744:                 batch_id=batch_id,
  745:                 event_type=f"batch.{next_status}",
  746:                 message={
  747:                     "running": "批次已开始或继续",
  748:                     "paused": "批次已暂停",
  749:                     "cancelled": "批次已取消",
  750:                 }[next_status],
  751:                 data={"previous_status": current_status, "action": action},
  752:             )
  753:         return self.get_batch(batch_id)
  754: 
  755:     def _retry_failed(
  756:         self, connection: sqlite3.Connection, batch_id: str, current_status: str
  757:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
  758:         if current_status not in {"failed", "completed", "cancelled"}:
  759:             raise InvalidTransitionError(f"批次处于 {current_status} 状态，不能重试失败项")
  760:         failed_count = connection.execute(
  761:             "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batch_items WHERE batch_id = ? AND status = 'failed'",
  762:             (batch_id,),
  763:         ).fetchone()[0]
  764:         if failed_count == 0:
  765:             raise InvalidTransitionError("批次中没有可重试的失败项")
  766:         now = utc_now()
  767:         connection.execute(
  768:             """
  769:             UPDATE batch_items
  770:             SET status = 'pending', stage = 'pending', attempt = attempt + 1,
  771:                 error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = ?
  772:             WHERE batch_id = ? AND status = 'failed'
  773:             """,
  774:             (now, batch_id),
  775:         )
  776:         connection.execute(
  777:             "UPDATE batches SET status = 'running', updated_at = ?, finished_at = NULL WHERE id = ?",
  778:             (now, batch_id),
  779:         )
  780:         self._insert_event(
  781:             connection,
  782:             batch_id=batch_id,
  783:             event_type="batch.retrying",
  784:             message=f"正在重试 {failed_count} 个失败 PID",
  785:             data={"failed_count": failed_count},
  786:         )
  787:         row = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM batches WHERE id = ?", (batch_id,)).fetchone()
  788:         return _decode_row(row)
  789: 
  790:     def update_item(self, item_id: str, **changes: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
  791:         allowed_fields = {
  792:             "status",
  793:             "stage",
  794:             "category",
  795:             "attempt",
  796:             "error_code",
  797:             "error_message",
  798:             "artifact_path",
  811:         assignments = ", ".join(f"{field} = ?" for field in normalized_changes)
  812:         values = [*normalized_changes.values(), item_id]
  813:         with self.database.connect() as connection:
  814:             connection.execute(
  815:                 f"UPDATE batch_items SET {assignments} WHERE id = ?", values
  816:             )
  817:             row = connection.execute(
  818:                 "SELECT * FROM batch_items WHERE id = ?", (item_id,)
  819:             ).fetchone()
  820:         if row is None:
  821:             raise NotFoundError("批次条目不存在")
  822:         return _decode_row(row)
